Get started with EpiTracer

Source: vignettes/epitracer.Rmd
epitracer.Rmd

EpiTracer detects extrachromosomal circular DNA (ecDNA) amplicons that were most likely generated by a simple excision and re-circularisation event — an episome — and visualises the structural rearrangements underlying focal amplifications, from whole-genome sequencing data.

Three short articles walk through the workflow, each end-to-end on bundled, synthetic example data (no patient data):

  1. Calling episomal ecDNA — call_episomal_ecdna(): flag amplicons that fit the episome model (with or without AmpliconArchitect seeds).
  2. Plotting copy number, SVs and kataegis — plot_sv_linear(): a copy-number / structural-variant viewer, with an optional stacked SNV (kataegis) panel.
  3. Reconstructing a focal amplicon wave by wave — plot_sv_reconstruction(): rebuild a complex amplicon stratified by read support.

Installation 

if (!requireNamespace("BiocManager", quietly = TRUE)) install.packages("BiocManager")
BiocManager::install("alhafidzhamdan/EpiTracer")

The bundled example data 

data(package = "EpiTracer")$results[, "Item"]
#> [1] "ex_caller_inputs" "ex_plot_inputs"   "ex_recon_inputs"  "ex_snv"
  • ex_caller_inputs — inputs for call_episomal_ecdna() (an episomal EGFR ecDNA).
  • ex_plot_inputs / ex_snv — inputs for plot_sv_linear() (an EGFR amplicon and a kataegis SNV set).
  • ex_recon_inputs — a complex CDK4 amplicon for plot_sv_reconstruction().
